Regarding the documentary on factory farming, its potential impact is likely to be significant in shifting public discourse and consumer behavior. By exposing the environmental degradation and animal welfare issues associated with industrial agriculture, the film may catalyze a decrease in demand for conventional meat and dairy products. This could accelerate the growth of the plant-based and cruelty-free food markets, prompting both consumers and policymakers to reconsider sustainable dietary choices and agricultural practices.
